name: The Retreat Salon
announcement: Now welcoming new guests in San Juan Capistrano
heroText: A beach-inspired escape for lived-in color, extensions and effortless cuts, minutes from the coast.
intro: The Retreat Salon is redefining the salon experience by blending high-end luxury with a laid-back, beach-inspired vibe, right in the heart of San Juan Capistrano. Designed to feel like your personal escape, with expert stylists delivering personalized, detail-driven services tailored to you.
location: Close to the Dana Point coastline, minutes from Historic Downtown SJC and River Street Marketplace. No shortage of great food, coffee and boutique shopping when you spend a day of self care at TRS.
servicesNote: Pricing is set by each stylist. Your stylist will go over it with you before your appointment.

faq.question: How much does a service cost?
faq.answer: Pricing varies by stylist and your hair. Your stylist will go over it with you before your appointment.

faq.question: I’m new. Who should I book with?
faq.answer: Choose “First available” or tell us your hair goals and we’ll match you with the right stylist.

faq.question: Do you do consultations?
faq.answer: Yes. Extensions always start with a consultation, and any color client is welcome to book one first.

faq.question: Where do I park?
faq.answer: Free parking is available in the lot outside Suite A.
